paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in Kiddushin 16b: Rav Sheshet said — as it was taught: Totai says, “to him and not to his creditor.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Kiddushin 16b paragraph has Abaye reporting Rav Sheshet’s explanation that the baraita is Totai’s, including “to him, and not to his creditor.” Hyman’s compressed presentation and the negation are retained. The supplied designation “a Tanna of a baraita” describes the cited source form; this review adds no generation, teacher, or legal material.
